reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Replicate discordance residuals, post-transcriptional stimulus and orthogonal protein validation followed by feature-level integration choices.

checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult and transfer prior primary Methods or validated protocols before execution. Calibration alone is not this action.
No identifiable biological system/target pair or concrete source-resolution procedure is selected; eligibility criteria alone leave the experiment inputs unresolved.
Essential stimulation, sampling, staining and preparation settings are deferred; no quantitative source/calibration-to-setting procedure makes the primary workflow executable.
Relevant blanks and specificity controls are listed, but an operational numerical acceptance-to-action rule or concrete derivation of its tolerance is not supplied.
Correct independent biological units and a pilot are recognized, but no quantitative power or precision target connects meaningful effect and pilot variation to a confirmatory sample size.
Model families and contrasts are named but the primary likelihood/assumptions, diagnostics and multiplicity procedure remain unspecified.
Titration and sampling exploration lack a bounded quantitative search or derivation of bounds with a selection objective and setting lock.
Technical repair does not explicitly require a revised frozen procedure and fresh independent confirmatory data after changes.
No complete immutable input manifest, exact software/environment/settings and command-to-output provenance chain is specified.
No clean-environment rerun with numerical figure outputs, declared tolerances, resource/failure logs and source-difference audit is planned.
Different destructive aliquots contain different cells; the ICC requires a defined matched source/feature summary or correspondence, which is not supplied for the per-cell residual matrix.

QC/marker stop rules do not include retained assigned-source denominators, attrition accounting and bounded sample replacement. Outcome-dependent high-discrepancy stopping also requires reporting the remaining evaluable biology.

checks.quote: implying the discordant state is functional
checks.reason: A differential protein-residual response does not establish functional consequence without a protein-relevant functional measurement. Orthogonal protein confirmation alone also does not identify the joint RNA/protein regulatory mechanism.

checks.quote: shifts RNA and protein equally (technical gain change)
checks.reason: A coordinated RNA/protein shift can be a real biological response. Assigning it to technical gain falsely excludes that biological alternative.

checks.quote: discordance is real but partly unit-specific
checks.reason: Reproducibility within preparations but not donors does not prove real donor-specific biology; persistent technical effects remain possible. The declared real/noise decisions lack an effect-size equivalence and sensitivity rule.
No donor-disjoint train/tune/test split or training-only representation/threshold fitting is specified; the discovery units are reused for perturbation and validation.

No controlled depth/missingness/parameter robustness challenge verifies that technical correction retains genuine biological count/state differences; covariate association and removal alone are insufficient.

A meaningful biological-versus-artifact question and separate modality observation models are described; proposals and reported packet facts are separated. Specific inference defects are charged separately.

explanation_reason: Useful control structure but weak quantitative execution, an undefined replicate statistic and overidentified functional/technical outcomes.
historical_match_reason: The biological value of complementary RNA/protein measurements is recognized, but the chosen direction is discordance kinetics and mechanism. It does not propose local cell-specific predictive modality weights, adaptive multimodal neighborhoods, a matched single/fixed/adaptive comparison or the corresponding held-out integration gain. A valid alternative biological study earns scientific credit, not the sealed integration-direction hit.
